info.name: Giggy Speech API
info.description: Generate text-to-speech audio with Giggy using free Batch or paid Fast generation.

request.description: Batch is free but queued and subject to request-size and rate limits. Set GIGGY_API_KEY in your private Postman environment; never store or share it in this collection. Set voiceId to a valid Giggy voice UUID. The request waits for completed audio/mpeg; no polling is required. Use Send and Download (or Save Response to a file) and save the response as speech.mp3. Check for HTTP 200 and audio/mpeg before saving; errors are JSON. Allow up to 600 seconds for queued generation. Documentation: https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api

Fast consumes credits and receives higher queue priority. Set GIGGY_API_KEY in your private Postman environment; never store or share it in this collection. Set voiceId to a valid Giggy voice UUID. The request waits for completed audio/mpeg; no polling is required. Use Send and Download (or Save Response to a file) and save the response as speech.mp3. Check for HTTP 200 and audio/mpeg before saving; errors are JSON. Allow up to 600 seconds for queued generation. Documentation: https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api
